dialogue.origin: よろしくお願い致します!
dialogue.content: It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: いけそうですか？
dialogue.content: Are you ready to begin?

dialogue.origin: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, it's a pleasure to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは本日はどのようなお悩みでご相談にこられましたか？
dialogue.content: Hello. What brings you to counseling today?

dialogue.origin: こんにちは今日は友達のことで相談に来ました
dialogue.content: Hello. I'd like to talk about my friends today.

dialogue.origin: ご友人の事で相談にこられたのですね
dialogue.content: I see. So you're here to talk about your friends.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にはどのような事ですか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me about it in more detail?

dialogue.origin: グループで仲良くしていたのに最近話しても避けられてるみたいで
dialogue.content: We were close as a group, but recently, even when I try to talk to them, it feels like they’re avoiding me.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは辛いですよね
dialogue.content: I see. That must be tough.

dialogue.origin: いつ頃から今の状況ですか？
dialogue.content: How long has this been going on?

dialogue.origin: とても辛いです
dialogue.content: It's very painful.

dialogue.origin: ほんとに最近なんです
dialogue.content: It only started very recently.

dialogue.origin: きっかけは分からない感じですか？
dialogue.content: Do you have any idea what might have triggered it?

dialogue.origin: 多分私が約束してたの家の用事で断ってしまったからだとおもうんです
dialogue.content: I think it's probably because I had to cancel our plans due to a family matter.

dialogue.origin: 約束してた用事を家の用事で断った事が原因だとお考えなのですね
dialogue.content: So you think the reason might be that you canceled your plans due to a family matter.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: グループの人々はどういう集まりなのですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of group is it?

dialogue.origin: クラスの友達です
dialogue.content: They're friends from my class.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 約束してた用事はどういったものだったのですか？
dialogue.content: What kind of plans did you have?

dialogue.origin: 家のどうしても外せない用事です
dialogue.content: It was a family matter that I absolutely couldn't miss.

dialogue.origin: 友達と約束してた方の内容を教えて頂きたくて質問しました
dialogue.content: I was asking about the details of the plans you had with your friends.

dialogue.origin: 分かりづらくてすみません
dialogue.content: I apologize if my question was unclear.

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: That's okay.

dialogue.origin: 断ってしまって謝ったときはうん、わかったていわれたんですけどね
dialogue.content: When I apologized for canceling, they said, "Okay, I get it," but...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、お友達とはどこかに出かける予定だったのですか？
dialogue.content: I see. So were you planning to go out somewhere with your friends?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: いつもとうり３人で遊ぶ約束でした
dialogue.content: It was our usual plan for the three of us to hang out.

dialogue.origin: よく遊ぶ3人なのですね
dialogue.content: So the three of you hang out often.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 断った予定は前々から計画してた大がかりなものなのか、気楽に遊ぼうといったものかどちらでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Was the plan you canceled something big that had been planned for a while, or was it more of a casual get-together?

dialogue.origin: 気楽にですよいつもそうなので
dialogue.content: It was casual. It always is.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そしたら今までも同じように断ることはありましたよね？
dialogue.content: I see. In that case, have you ever had to cancel in a similar way before?

dialogue.origin: 断るのはなかったですね
dialogue.content: No, I've never had to cancel before.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ただ、気楽に遊ぼうといった約束を1回断っただけで避けられのは何でだろうと思いますよね？
dialogue.content: Still, it makes you wonder why they would avoid you just for turning down a casual hangout once, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 避けられていると感じるときはどんな感情になりますか？
dialogue.content: When you feel they’re avoiding you, what feelings come up for you?

dialogue.origin: とても悲しいきもちになってしまいます
dialogue.content: I end up feeling very sad.

dialogue.origin: 当然、悲しくなますよね、、、
dialogue.content: Of course, it's natural to feel sad...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今の状況がどうなったらいいなと思われていますか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to see happen in this situation?

dialogue.origin: また前みたいに遊べたらって思いますけど難しいと思うので
dialogue.content: I'd like for us to hang out like we used to, but I think that will be difficult.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね難しいと思うのは、なぜですか？
dialogue.content: I see. What makes you think it would be difficult?

dialogue.origin: 無視されてるんで避けられたり
dialogue.content: Because they're ignoring me and avoiding me.

dialogue.origin: 質問が難しいですかね？
dialogue.content: Is my question difficult?

dialogue.origin: いえ
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: ではなぜ、前のように戻るのは思われましたか？
dialogue.content: Then, why do you think it's difficult to go back to how things were before?

dialogue.origin: 日本語の意味が分かりにくいです
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, I'm finding your wording a bit hard to understand.

dialogue.origin: 今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you.

topic.sub: 友達とのコミュニケーション問題
